blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu – The Mandaue City Government is being urged to establish a dedicated cybersecurity unit and strengthen its data protection systems to protect government digital assets and sensitive personal information of constituents amid the rising threat of cyberattacks. The City Council passed a resolution directing the city’s Management Information Systems Office (MISO), in coordination with the Office of the City Mayor, to implement comprehensive cybersecurity measures and establish specialized units to strengthen the city’s defenses against cyber threats.
